importance_detail.rationale: The bill broadens Department of Veterans Affairs burial benefits by allowing individuals furnished an urn or commemorative plaque to also receive a headstone, marker, or national cemetery interment. The effect is limited in fiscal and population scope, applying retroactively to deaths on or after January 5, 2021.
